findings.description: The bucket has no ACL specified but is commented as public, has no server-side encryption configuration, no versioning, and no access logging, exposing customer data (customer-master.xlsx) to unauthorized access and tampering.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so data stored in this bucket is not encrypted at rest.
A sensitive file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded to the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, which is public and unencrypted, directly exposing customer master data to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket holding financial data, leaving it unencrypted at rest.
Versioning is not enabled, increasing risk of unrecoverable data loss or undetected tampering of financial records; combined with force_destroy=true this raises risk of irreversible data loss.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, so operational data is stored unencrypted.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving data science datasets unencrypted at rest.
